needs_review.issue: Deaf ministry/sign language searches returned no individual staff pages
needs_review.finding: While Wycliffe has documented Deaf Bible translation work and mentions of sign language projects, search results returned only program pages and news articles, not individual staff member profiles matching the site:wycliffe.org/partner pattern
needs_review.evidence: Blog posts about Deaf translation and program descriptions, but no /partner/<slug> pages for sign language workers
needs_review.recommendation: May indicate Deaf ministry staff use alternative naming conventions or are not yet indexed in the partner directory; recheck wave t's coverage

needs_review.finding: Search returned resource pages and blog posts about OBS methodology but not named staff pages in /partner/<slug> format
needs_review.evidence: Reference to 'Kathy' developing OBS sets but no direct /partner/ profile link provided
needs_review.recommendation: Name and specific profile URL unclear; may need direct URL verification if pursuing this lead

needs_review.issue: Language survey search returned names but without verification URLs
needs_review.finding: Results mention Devin and Mary O'Bannon and reference Steve & Janice Quakenbush in language survey context, but limited direct profile information
needs_review.evidence: Text mentions from search results, names appear in wave t's held list (Quakenbush)
needs_review.recommendation: Held surname rules these out; Devin O'Bannon not in held list but profile URL unconfirmed in search results

needs_review.issue: Film, radio, arts searches not executed
needs_review.finding: Due to 18-search budget constraint, did not query specifically for film, radio, or arts roles, though 'media' was searched broadly
needs_review.evidence: Budget exhausted by other role searches with priority on broader terminology
needs_review.recommendation: These roles remain untouched; sibling wave agents may pursue if needed
